resources.string: A NextVol backup contains selected library data, not the original EPUB or TXT files. Keep those files separately. After restoring on another device, use “Relink original file” on each local book to keep its reading position and bookmarks.
Your bookshelf, reading progress and bookmarks are saved. Select the original EPUB or TXT file to read this book on this device.
The book keeps its existing identity, bookshelf entries, progress and bookmarks. No duplicate book is created.
The original file and chapter mapping match the backup.
This is a different or modified original file. Choose the unchanged original. You can import this version as a separate book from your bookshelf.
The chapter mapping or text differs. For TXT, use the original encoding and chapter rule. If they cannot be matched, import this file as a separate book.
This backup has no original file record and cannot be relinked. Import the file as a new book from your bookshelf.
